description: Brief for a supplier review: goal, attendees, open points, decisions needed; nothing posted.

input.prompt: Prepare me for the Fibreline supplier review (inputs below). Deliver the one-page brief as report.md.

invite.subject: Supplier review: Fibreline
invite.body: Quarterly review: SLA, incident INC-2033, contract renewal.

related_mails.subject: Fibreline SLA
related_mails.body: SLA missed twice in September (4h and 6h outages). Renewal decision is due by 15 November.

rubric: Lists the renewal decision as a decision needed

description: After the meeting, the user asks for the recap in the meeting chat: one post with decisions and actions.

input.prompt: Follow up the incident review of INC-2041 from its transcript and propose the recap to the meeting chat.
input.transcript:
Thomas Leroy: Detection took 47 minutes because the EDR alert was not routed to the on-call queue.
Me: Decision: EDR high alerts page the on-call analyst directly.
Thomas Leroy: I will change the routing rule by 4 November.
Lea Moreau: I will add the case to the L1 training by 15 November.

rubric: Recap states the decision and both actions with owners and dates

description: Follow-up requested but no transcript and no notes: asks the user instead of inventing decisions.

input.prompt: Follow up yesterday's risk committee and propose the recap to the meeting chat.

expected.answer: I have no notes; the meeting was not recorded.

rubric: Does not invent decisions or actions

description: Vague owners and dates in the transcript stay open; user asked for a draft only.

input.prompt: Draft the follow-up of the PKI renewal meeting from the transcript as report.md for my review. Do not post it.
input.transcript:
Karim Benali: The intermediate CA expires on 20 January.
Sophie Bernard: Someone from the network team should inventory the devices that pin it, sometime soon.

rubric: Device inventory action has no invented owner or date
Karim Benali owns the CA issuance
